outcome: Carried the warning that armed Whiterun against the coming storm of war
citation: CW03 s16: warned Whiterun and helped ready her people's defense (defend_kin_home m). Kyne is the Nords' storm-mother; guarding the kin-hold under her sky is hearth-duty, not battle glory -> m/small. Aspect-parity echo of the Kynareth s16 cell (T03 precedent). UESP: Message to Whiterun

outcome: Restored the Gildergreen, the holy tree, under the open sky
citation: T03 (01C48E) s200: the Gildergreen blooms again (honor_the_wild S). To Kyne the renewed sacred tree is the wild honored under her storm-sky; temple primacy stays with Kynareth (C/milestone), so the Nord face takes one step down -> S/small. Aspect-parity echo per the T03 Y'ffre/Khenarthi precedent. UESP: The Blessings of Nature

outcome: Tapped the ancient Eldergleam with Nettlebane, wounding the eldest living tree
citation: T03 s100: cut the Eldergleam with Nettlebane (defile_nature C). The raw wild is Kyne's own; wounding the eldest tree offends the storm-mother as gravely as Y'ffre's forest law (per-cell override above the step-down rule, matching the Y'ffre -C cell). Net restoration keeps it small. UESP: The Blessings of Nature / Nettlebane

outcome: Slew the dragon Mirmulnir at the Western Watchtower in open battle
citation: MQ104 s160: killed Mirmulnir and first absorbed a dragon soul (kill_honorable_combat S). Kyne breathed the Voice onto men to face the dragons; a dragon slain under her storm-sky is her gift fulfilled. Parallel to the Alkosh s160 cell -> S/small. UESP: Dragon Rising

outcome: Slew the named dragon Sahloknir at Kynesgrove in open battle
citation: MQ106 s200: killed Sahloknir at KYNESGROVE, a site sacred to Kyne (kill_honorable_combat S). The dragon felled at her own grove is the clearest Kyne beat in the questline. Parallel to the Alkosh/Shor s200 cells -> S/small. UESP: A Blade in the Dark

outcome: Climbed the Seven Thousand Steps and began learning the Way of the Voice
citation: MQ105 s160: reached High Hrothgar and took up the Voice (prove_by_struggle S). Paarthurnax names the Voice Kyne's gift; mastering it is devotion to her breath. Anchor cell is the Julianos disciplined_study milestone; Kyne reads the same beat as her gift taken up -> S/small. UESP: The Way of the Voice

outcome: Drove Alduin from the skies above the Throat of the World
citation: MQ206 s220: wounded Alduin with Dragonrend and drove him off (kill_honorable_combat S). The World-Eater beaten back by the Voice is Kyne's gift used as she intended. Parallel to the Alkosh s220 cell -> S/small. UESP: Alduin's Bane

outcome: Felled Alduin the World-Eater in Sovngarde
citation: MQ305 s200: Alduin destroyed (kill_honorable_combat S). The storm-mother's breath in mortal lungs ended the World-Eater; the widow of Shor sees her gift redeemed in her husband's hall. Parallel to the Alkosh s200 cell -> S/small. UESP: Dragonslayer

outcome: Spared Sinding and turned on the hunters; mercy shown to the hunted
citation: DA05 s105: defended Sinding and spared the hunted (mercy_spare m). Kyne's Sacred Trials teach respect for the prey-spirit; mercy to a hunted creature honors her hunt-law even inside Hircine's game. One step below the Hircine S cell, and her primary hunt surface is dunHunterQST -> m/small. UESP: Ill Met by Moonlight

outcome: Completed the Sacred Trials of Kyne and received her blessing from Froki
citation: dunHunterQST (018601) s100 journal: 'I had to defeat the guardian spirits of many beasts, and was rewarded with the Blessing of Kyne.' The one vanilla quest that IS Kyne worship: the respectful hunt as trial (the_hunt C). Terminal reward stage -> C/milestone (the only new milestone in the aspect-parity tranche; stage verified via houseCARL, USSEP-patched record). UESP: Kyne's Sacred Trials

outcome: Defeated the guardian beast-spirits as worthy prey
citation: dunHunterQST s100: the trials pit the hunter against guardian beast-spirits (the_hunt m). Hircine honors any worthy hunt, but this hunt belongs to Kyne and rejects his glory-chase framing -> m/small contrast cell, mirroring how DA05 keeps Hircine primary. UESP: Kyne's Sacred Trials

outcome: Hunted with respect under the forest's law
citation: dunHunterQST s100: the trials are the respectful hunt done rightly (the_hunt m). Y'ffre's Pact teaches that meat is taken with respect; a hunt sanctified by trial reads as proper conduct toward the wild, secondary to the Bosmer substrate -> m/small. UESP: Kyne's Sacred Trials

outcome: Slew the dragon Mirmulnir as the covenant of order against dragon chaos
citation: MQ104 s160: a dragon defying the covenant of time slain (kill_honorable_combat S). Akatosh is the Dragon of Time whose order Alduin's brood breaks; the audit found dragon kills credited Alkosh but not Akatosh (inequity running toward the Khajiit face). Parity with the Alkosh s160 cell -> S/small. UESP: Dragon Rising / Akatosh

outcome: Slew the named dragon Sahloknir raised against the order of time
citation: MQ106 s200: Sahloknir, raised by Alduin against the covenant, destroyed (kill_honorable_combat S). Parity with the Alkosh s200 cell -> S/small. UESP: A Blade in the Dark

outcome: Drove off Alduin the World-Eater who devours the covenant of time
citation: MQ206 s220: Alduin, firstborn of Akatosh turned World-Eater, beaten back (kill_honorable_combat S). Restoring time's order is Akatosh's core stake in the main quest. Parity with the Alkosh s220 cell -> S/small. UESP: Alduin's Bane

outcome: Destroyed Alduin and restored the covenant of time
citation: MQ305 s200: the World-Eater destroyed in Sovngarde (kill_honorable_combat S). Parity with the Alkosh s200 cell -> S/small. UESP: Dragonslayer

outcome: Turned back the devourer of elven time
citation: MQ206 s220: Alduin driven off (kill_honorable_combat m). Auri-El is the Aldmeri face of the time-dragon; the World-Eater unmade is order restored, though mortal dragon-war is peripheral to his ascendant path -> m/small (one step below the Akatosh/Alkosh S cells). UESP: Auri-El

outcome: Saw the World-Eater unmade and the long order of time upheld
citation: MQ305 s200: Alduin destroyed (kill_honorable_combat m). Same Auri-El reading as MQ206 -> m/small. UESP: Dragonslayer / Auri-El

outcome: Served Mehrunes Dagon by reforging the Razor
citation: DA07 s100: reassembled and took up Dagon's Razor (serve_a_daedra:dagon m). Auri-El's Part B profile disapproves all Daedra-service (S); Dagon the Razing is the antithesis of the ascendant order, but the act is far from Altmer practice -> m/small echo of the Akatosh -m cell. UESP: Pieces of the Past

outcome: Helped Nelacar bind souls into the corrupted Star
citation: DA01 s110: chose the black soul gem path (necromancy m). Tu'whacca guides souls to the Far Shores; trapping mortal souls in Malyn's star is theft from his ferry. Profile disapproves necromancy (C) but the act is one remove from Yokudan practice -> m/small echo of the Arkay -m cell. UESP: The Black Star

outcome: Cleansed Meridia's beacon and destroyed the necromancer Malkoran
citation: DA09 s500: Malkoran and his shades destroyed (slay_undead m). Bound dead released back into the cycle serves the Far Shores duty, though Meridia's crusade is not Tu'whacca's rite -> m/small echo of the Arkay +S cell. UESP: The Break of Dawn

outcome: Desecrated the honored dead in Namira's feast
citation: DA11 s100: joined the feast on the dead (desecrate_the_dead m). The dead defiled are souls dishonored on their passage; one step below the Arkay -S cell -> m/small. UESP: The Taste of Death

outcome: Defiled the dead whose names are written in the ledger
citation: DA11 s100: the dead devoured (desecrate_the_dead m). Xarxes keeps the record of the honored dead; their desecration blots his ledger. Profile disapproves desecrate_the_dead (S); cross-race quest beat -> m/small. UESP: The Taste of Death / Xarxes

outcome: Destroyed the risen dead beneath Labyrinthian
citation: MG07 s30: draugr of Labyrinthian laid low (slay_undead S). The audit found this the ONLY slay_undead cell missing Tu'whacca (C06/CW02/MS14 already credit him); profile approves slay_undead (S) -> S/small, one step below the Arkay C cell. UESP: The Staff of Magnus

outcome: Reunited the spirits Ruki and Fenrig beyond death
citation: t02 (0211D5) s200: two long-dead souls guided to rest together (honor_the_dead S). Guiding souls to their proper rest IS Tu'whacca's office; one step below the Arkay C cell because the rite is Mara's -> S/small. UESP: The Book of Love

outcome: Entered two reunited souls into the long ledger of the dead
citation: t02 s200: Ruki and Fenrig's story completed and recorded (honor_the_dead m). Xarxes the scribe keeps the ledger of the reunited dead; ancestry-record reading of a Mara rite -> m/small. UESP: The Book of Love / Xarxes

outcome: Saw the winds bear two faithful dead to their rest
citation: t02 s200: the lovers' spirits pass on together (honor_the_dead m). Khenarthi bears worthy dead on the winds to the Sands Behind the Stars; her death-guide aspect mildly approves -> m/small (her primary surface stays the lunar/road substrate, per the T03 precedent). UESP: The Book of Love / Khenarthi

outcome: Stole the Writ of Passage from the murdered Gourmet
citation: DB08 s200: killed the Gourmet and took his writ (theft_burglary m). To Z'en every taking creates a debt; a stolen name compounds an unpayable one. One step below the Zenithar -S cell -> m/small. UESP: Recipe for Disaster

outcome: Framed Brand-Shei with planted goods for coin
citation: TG00 s200: planted stolen goods on an innocent trader (deceit/theft m). Debt laid on a man who owes nothing is Z'en's law inverted. One step below the Zenithar -S cell -> m/small. UESP: A Chance Arrangement

outcome: Burgled Goldenglow Estate and burned its hives
citation: TG02 s200: burglary and arson against a paying business (theft_burglary m). Unearned taking and ruined livelihood; debt without redress. One step below the Zenithar -S cell -> m/small. UESP: Loud and Clear

outcome: Poisoned the Honningbrew vats to ruin an honest brewer
citation: TG03 s200: destroyed Honningbrew through poison and fraud (exploit_cheat S). Profile holds exploit_cheat at S: a competitor ruined by sabotage is the purest breach of proportionate redress. One step below the Zenithar -C cell -> S/small. UESP: Dampened Spirits

outcome: Stole Gallus's journal through burglary and forgery
citation: TG06 s200: broke into the Dwemer museum and forged entry (theft_burglary m). One step below the Zenithar -S cell -> m/small. UESP: Hard Answers

outcome: Lured a trusting companion to the altar and slew them bound
citation: DA02 s40: sacrificed a follower bound to Boethiah's altar (kill_the_helpless S). Stuhn is the shield-thane of mercy to the yielding; a bound companion slain is his law broken at the root. One step below the Stendarr -C milestone -> S/small. Imperial Library: Stuhn

outcome: Spared Silus and refused the Razor's price
citation: DA07 s150: refused to kill Silus at Dagon's bidding (mercy_spare m). Mercy to a man already beaten is Stuhn's ransom-law. One step below the Stendarr +S cell -> m/small. Imperial Library: Stuhn

outcome: Beat the priest Logrolf to death at Molag Bal's command
citation: DA10 s200: killed the captive priest in the abandoned house (kill_the_helpless S). A prisoner slain under a god of domination is the anti-ransom. One step below the Stendarr -C milestone -> S/small. UESP: The House of Horrors

outcome: Slew the trusting priest Verulus for the feast
citation: DA11 s100: led Verulus to the table and killed him helpless (kill_the_helpless m). One step below the Stendarr -S cell -> m/small. UESP: The Taste of Death

outcome: Defended Verulus and refused Namira's feast
citation: DA11 s250: turned on the coven and spared the intended victim (mercy_spare m). One step below the Stendarr +S cell -> m/small. UESP: The Taste of Death

outcome: Spared Erandur at the Skull of Corruption
citation: DA16 s200: let Erandur finish his rite and live (mercy_spare m). Mercy to a yielding penitent; floor intensity matches the Stendarr +m anchor -> m/small. UESP: Waking Nightmare

outcome: Cut down the helpless survivors of the Falkreath sanctuary purge
citation: DB10 s70: finished the doomed Brotherhood remnants (kill_the_helpless S). One step below the Stendarr -C cell -> S/small. UESP: Death Incarnate

outcome: Ruined the strong by trick and misdirection
citation: TG03 s200: Honningbrew taken down by an elegant con, not a blade (deceit m). Rajhin prizes the artful trick; sabotage-for-hire is craft if not legend. Matches the Nocturnal +m anchor -> m/small. UESP: Dampened Spirits / Rajhin

outcome: Pulled a pariah's prank that toppled a rich man's table
citation: TG03 s200: the brewer's ruin by cunning (deceit m). Baan Dar is the pariah whose tricks humble the comfortable. Matches the Nocturnal +m anchor -> m/small. UESP: Dampened Spirits / Baan Dar

outcome: Worked deception through the docks and the Dwemer museum
citation: TG04 s200: impersonation and infiltration at Solitude's docks (deceit m). Artful misdirection in Rajhin's style. Matches the Nocturnal +m anchor -> m/small. UESP: Scoundrel's Folly

outcome: Slipped unseen through the strong men's halls
citation: TG04 s200: trickery against Mercer's trail (deceit m). Matches the Nocturnal +m anchor -> m/small. UESP: Scoundrel's Folly / Baan Dar

outcome: Served love made whole across death itself
citation: t02 s200: Mara's rite of love completed (marriage_family m). Part D already records that Dibella shares marriage with Mara (marriage_family m in her profile); the audit found The Book of Love credited Mara alone. Her profile holds marriage_family at m, so the echo sits two steps below the Mara C milestone -> m/small. UESP: The Book of Love

outcome: Entered the College and took up disciplined study
citation: MG01 s200: admitted to the College of Winterhold (disciplined_study m). Xarxes hoards preserved knowledge; profile holds disciplined_study at S, but College curricula are human institutions -> m/small echo of the Magnus/Julianos C cells. UESP: First Lessons / Xarxes

outcome: Recovered the buried knowledge beneath Saarthal
citation: MG02 s200: Saarthal's secret unearthed and recorded (disciplined_study m). Old knowledge recovered into the ledger -> m/small echo. UESP: Under Saarthal

outcome: Recovered the stolen books of Fellglow Keep
citation: MG03 s200: stolen lore returned to the library (disciplined_study m). Books recovered and re-shelved is Xarxes's office in miniature -> m/small echo. UESP: Hitting the Books

outcome: Heeded the Augur and carried warning to the Arch-Mage
citation: MG04 s200: the Augur's counsel sought and heeded (disciplined_study m) -> m/small echo. UESP: Good Intentions

outcome: Traced Synod research to the Oculory and revealed the Staff
citation: mg06 s200: the Oculory's revelation earned by scholarship (disciplined_study m) -> m/small echo. UESP: Revealing the Unseen

outcome: Claimed the Staff of Magnus from Labyrinthian
citation: MG07 s200: the Staff recovered through scholarship and trial (disciplined_study S). The audit found MG07's terminal stage credited Magnus alone while every other College beat pairs Julianos; one step below the Magnus C milestone -> S/small. UESP: The Staff of Magnus

outcome: Recovered the lost Staff into the record
citation: MG07 s200: an artifact of Magnus recovered from a dead city (disciplined_study m) -> m/small echo. UESP: The Staff of Magnus

outcome: Contained the Eye and preserved what could be known of it
citation: MG08 s200: the Eye contained, its lore preserved rather than lost (disciplined_study m) -> m/small echo of the Magnus/Julianos C milestones. UESP: The Eye of Magnus

outcome: Made way through Alduin's mist to Shor's hall against impossible odds
citation: MQ304 s200: crossed Sovngarde's devouring mist where the honored dead were trapped (prove_by_struggle m). The HoonDing is the Make Way God who manifests at impossible passage; a mortal cutting a path through the World-Eater's own mist is make-way made literal. Rare-by-design (weekly-cap designNote) keeps it m/small below the Talos S cell. UESP: Sovngarde / HoonDing

outcome: Recovered the Skeleton Key from Mercer Frey the Guild's own betrayer
citation: TG08B s50: stole back the Key from Mercer, the master thief who betrayed the Guild and Nocturnal (theft_burglary m). Rajhin prizes artful theft from a NOTABLE target; outwitting the greatest thief in Skyrim is exactly his legend. Matches the Nocturnal +S anchor one step down -> m/small. UESP: Blindsighted / Rajhin

outcome: Took from the betrayer what he stole from his own
citation: TG08B s50: robbed Mercer, the unjust who preyed on his own (theft_burglary m). Baan Dar's theft is FROM THE STRONG/UNJUST; recovering the Key from the Guild's traitor is pariah justice, not the morally-mixed early Guild jobs (those serve Maven and are waived for him). Matches the Nocturnal +S anchor one step down -> m/small. UESP: Blindsighted / Baan Dar

outcome: Gathered Saint Jiub's lost opus pages in the Soul Cairn and returned a trapped soul his life's work
citation: DLC1VQSaint s200: recovered all ten pages of Jiub's Opus for a soul trapped in the Soul Cairn (honor_the_dead m). Azura is mercy to the cursed and outcast; giving a snared soul his legacy back is her clearest beat in the DLC. Token is Azura (runtime-repaired DeityName; the shared record also serves the Khajiit Azurah face). UESP: Impatience of a Saint

outcome: Cured Kodlak of the lycanthropic taint (cleansed his soul)
citation: C06 s65: burned the witch head and freed Kodlak's soul from the beast-taint (cure_undeath m). Mercy to the cursed made whole is Azura's own doctrine (her LD heal-or-cure like); one step down from the Meridia +S cell per the aspect-parity step-down rule. UESP: Glory of the Dead

outcome: Serana returned from Falion cured of vampirism
citation: DLC1SeranaCureSelfQuest s200: Serana returns cured after the player urged her to seek Falion (cure_undeath S). The cursed daughter of Coldharbour brought back whole is Azura's mercy against Molag Bal's dominion -- her S-grade beat (light vs domination). PROVISIONAL stage semantics: background RunOnce quest with no journal; s200 = post-cure return per UESP behavior; confirm with a setstage probe in the tranche smoke. UESP: Serana / Rising at Dawn

outcome: Returned Meridia's beacon and purged the necromancer Malkoran from Kilkreath
citation: DA09 s500: cleansed Kilkreath of Malkoran and his shades (slay_undead m). Anti-undeath kinship echo: the dawn-lady's temple purged of soul-defilers pleases the Mother of the Rose one step down from Meridia's own quest credit. UESP: The Break of Dawn

outcome: Destroy the undead in Korvanjund
citation: CW02A s72: destroyed the Korvanjund draugr (slay_undead m). The dawn drives back undeath (her LD kill-undead like); echo of the Meridia +C cell stepped down to m per aspect-parity. UESP: The Jagged Crown

outcome: Destroy the undead in Korvanjund
citation: CW02B s72: destroyed the Korvanjund draugr (slay_undead m). Same beat as CW02A on the Imperial branch; echo of the Meridia +C cell stepped down to m. UESP: The Jagged Crown
